notes.title: Big Renovation Update
notes.notes:
Professor Kirchhoff made major renovations on his estate. Enjoy greatly improved graphics, better game performance and an overall smoother experience! Here's a full list of improvements:

- Improved graphics
- Improved game performance
- Added resolution and quality settings
- Settings can also be changed while playing
- More responsive controls
- Exterminated bugs

notes.title: Full release expected last week of December
notes.notes: The problems with time-dependent circuits appear to be under control, but we still need to test on more platforms. Also, we will need to add support for Catalina. Please stay tuned for a release during the last week of December. Thank you for your patience!
